$comment: Structured version of v5/ANTI_AI_VISUAL_FINGERPRINTS.md. Consumed by tools/v5/authenticity_check.py and any downstream QA agent. Severities: blocker | high | medium | low.

fingerprints.title: Universal section divider
fingerprints.description: Hairline horizontal rule between most or all top-level sections.
fingerprints.why_ai: Cheapest way to say 'the section ended'. Humans use whitespace/typography for the same job and reach for a rule only when it is a chosen editorial signature.

css_properties.border-top: any hairline (1px) with alpha < 0.2 repeated on multiple top-level sections

detection.layout_signal: presence of a repeated divider component between sibling <section> elements

fingerprints.correction: Delete every divider. If boundary feels unclear, follow DIVIDER_POLICY.md escalation: whitespace -> compositional shift -> typography -> surface.

fingerprints.title: Decorative technical grid overlay
fingerprints.description: Full-page background of thin vertical and horizontal lines, often at low opacity on a dark surface.
fingerprints.why_ai: Signals 'technical' or 'engineered' without any engineering content underneath. Atmosphere without evidence.

css_properties.background-image: repeating linear-gradient defining a grid at 10-40px units with alpha 0.03-0.08
css_properties.background-size: small tile size with grid pattern

fingerprints.correction: Remove the pattern. Do not replace with another atmospheric device.

fingerprints.title: Hairline card borders
fingerprints.description: Every card carries a barely-visible outline like border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06).
fingerprints.why_ai: Template default, not a containment decision.

css_properties.border: 1px stroke with alpha < 0.15 repeated across many card-like components

fingerprints.correction: Ask whether the card is needed at all (COMPOSITION_RESTRAINT.md). If yes, use surface contrast. If no, remove the container.

fingerprints.title: Corner and register marks for atmosphere
fingerprints.description: L-shaped brackets, corner ticks, viewfinder marks placed around empty areas or headings.
fingerprints.why_ai: Engineering-mimicry with no engineering intent.

detection.svg_signal: small L-shaped or bracket SVG paths in corners of containers without associated data

fingerprints.correction: Remove.

fingerprints.title: Universal fade-up entrance
fingerprints.description: opacity 0 -> 1 with translateY(20-40px) -> 0 applied as scroll-triggered reveal on multiple sections.
fingerprints.why_ai: The single strongest AI motion fingerprint. Reveals that the page was assembled by a system.

detection.js_signal: single IntersectionObserver reveal helper attached to many elements
detection.gsap_signal: gsap.from(..., { opacity: 0, y: 20-40 }) called with same params across many selectors
detection.css_signal: repeated identical transform: translateY(N) keyframe values across sections

fingerprints.correction: Delete the helper. Pick one section that genuinely benefits from an entrance and animate only that, using a grammar that fits that section. Leave everything else static.

fingerprints.title: Stagger ladder
fingerprints.description: Children of a list animate with delays index * 0.1s.
fingerprints.why_ai: Code pattern, not a design decision. Real staggers reflect reading order or causality, not array index.

detection.js_signal: delay: index * 0.1 or i * 0.1 or 100 * i patterns

fingerprints.correction: Remove the stagger, or stagger by hierarchy (primary first, then supports together after a beat).

fingerprints.title: Identical easing across roles
fingerprints.description: UI microfeedback, editorial reveals, camera moves, and 3D motion share the same easing token.
fingerprints.why_ai: Perceived mass and function should shape easing. When they do not, the system is defaulting.

detection.css_variables: fewer than 3 distinct easing values across UI/editorial/object roles
detection.code_signal: single --ease or --transition token applied to every animated property

fingerprints.correction: Define at least three easing families: ui, editorial, object. Assign by role.

fingerprints.title: Blur-in on entrance
fingerprints.description: filter: blur(8px) -> blur(0) on entrance without focal-plane logic.
fingerprints.why_ai: Blur used without communicative purpose. Exists to feel premium.

detection.css_signal: filter: blur(Npx) in keyframes or animation from/to states

fingerprints.correction: Delete. Use settle grammar if more weight is needed.

fingerprints.title: Motion without rest zones
fingerprints.description: Every viewport range on a multi-viewport page has some element in motion.
fingerprints.why_ai: Continuous stimulation flattens hierarchy. Nothing feels important because everything moves.

detection.layout_signal: no top-level section on a page longer than 2 viewports has zero motion attached

fingerprints.correction: Designate at least two rest zones per long page (REST_ZONES.md). Total rest coverage >= 30% on long pages.

fingerprints.title: Centered hero cliche
fingerprints.description: Small centered eyebrow + oversized centered grotesk + one-line paragraph + primary/secondary CTA + radial glow behind.
fingerprints.why_ai: Safest 'looks like a hero' layout. Announces the system, not the product.

detection.layout_signal: hero root with text-align: center, max-width text block, 2-button flex row, radial-gradient behind

fingerprints.correction: Move copy off-center; asymmetric split; full-bleed image with overlapping type; single editorial sentence with no CTA. Break the reflex.

fingerprints.title: Cardification of everything
fingerprints.description: More than 60% of leaf content blocks share identical container shape (radius + border + padding + background).
fingerprints.why_ai: Cards became the default rendering unit. No containment decision was made per block.

detection.layout_signal: ratio of .card-shaped components to unique content shapes very high
detection.css_signal: same (border-radius, border, padding, background) tuple repeated on many components

fingerprints.correction: See COMPOSITION_RESTRAINT.md. Delete containers whose contents do not need a boundary.

fingerprints.title: Three-equal-cards feature grid
fingerprints.description: Features section with exactly three cards of equal size, each icon + heading + line.
fingerprints.why_ai: Content rarely has three peer concepts. Rendering three equals says the system defaulted to a shape.

detection.css_signal: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) under a features section
detection.data_signal: three-item array in a features config

fingerprints.correction: If content really has three peers, vary size or emphasis. If primary + two supports, render one large + two smaller.

fingerprints.title: Bento as default layout
fingerprints.description: Mixed-size tile grid chosen for visual variety, not because different content has different footprints.
fingerprints.why_ai: Bento solves a specific problem. Applied without that problem, tile sizes read as arbitrary.

detection.layout_signal: grid with mixed span values on content units of similar density/importance

fingerprints.correction: Justify each tile size by content density. Otherwise use uniform grid or drop the grid.

fingerprints.title: Decorative metadata pills
fingerprints.description: Small pill labels ('NEW', 'AI-POWERED', tag chips) that do not link, filter, or indicate state.
fingerprints.why_ai: Real metadata does something. Decorative metadata is costume.

detection.layout_signal: pill component used more than 3 times on a marketing page without filter/link/state association

fingerprints.correction: Delete pills that do not act. If the label carries information, use a typographic treatment.

fingerprints.title: Default dark + hairlines + accent glow
fingerprints.description: Near-black background, hairlines at low alpha, single radial gradient in saturated brand color behind hero.
fingerprints.why_ai: Standard 'premium tech' fallback. Signals composition effort was skipped.

detection.css_signal: body background near #0A0A0B, strokes at rgba(255,255,255, <0.15), one large radial-gradient behind hero

fingerprints.correction: Either commit to darkness with real depth (imagery, materials, type) or move to a lighter surface. Kill the accent glow.

fingerprints.title: Unmotivated blue-purple gradient
fingerprints.description: Blue-to-purple or purple-to-pink gradient used as brand identity for anything 'tech' or 'AI'.
fingerprints.why_ai: Decade-long AI/SaaS default. Choosing it says color decision was skipped.

detection.css_signal: gradient stops in 210-290 deg hue range with high chroma

fingerprints.correction: Color must come from brand, material, image, or chosen source. Pick a single flat color if a signal is needed.

fingerprints.title: Gradient headline as identity
fingerprints.description: Primary headline uses background-clip: text with a gradient fill.
fingerprints.why_ai: Type has no character without the gradient. Gradient is compensating.

detection.css_signal: background-clip: text or -webkit-background-clip: text on H1 or hero headline

fingerprints.correction: Fix the type first. If a single-color headline does not carry identity, the type system is wrong.

fingerprints.title: Glassmorphism spam
fingerprints.description: Multiple frosted-glass panels stacked as generic premium signal without a scene behind them.
fingerprints.why_ai: Glass is a spatial device. Without a spatial world, it is texture hiding flatness.

detection.css_signal: more than 2 backdrop-filter: blur(...) elements on one screen without underlying imagery

fingerprints.correction: If there is a scene behind, one glass panel is fine. If not, glass is the wrong device.

fingerprints.title: Oversized centered grotesk headline
fingerprints.description: Very large sans-serif headline, centered, only 'big' typographic moment on the page.
fingerprints.why_ai: Safest possible display decision. Signals big made-it-big, no editorial thinking.

detection.css_signal: H1 with text-align: center and font-size >= 6vw, in a fashionable startup grotesk

fingerprints.correction: Asymmetry, mixed weight/width, or a different typographic voice.

fingerprints.title: Mono developer costume
fingerprints.description: Monospace face used for body, headings, and nav to signal 'developer product'.
fingerprints.why_ai: Mono is a role, not a costume.

detection.css_signal: monospace family applied to body copy or primary nav; decorative $ or > characters

fingerprints.correction: Reserve mono for code and precise data. Use a real body face.

fingerprints.title: All-caps eyebrow spam
fingerprints.description: Every section leads with a small all-caps wide-tracked label.
fingerprints.why_ai: Repetition reveals it as a template slot rather than a chapter marker.

detection.css_signal: repeated text-transform: uppercase on small label at the top of every section

fingerprints.correction: Delete most. Keep one or two where the chapter marker is genuinely useful.

fingerprints.title: Scale-only hierarchy
fingerprints.description: Hierarchy expressed only through font-size. Weight, width, case, tracking, family stay constant.
fingerprints.why_ai: Laziest use of type. Real hierarchy uses multiple axes.

detection.css_signal: type scale where all headings share the same weight and family, differ only by size

fingerprints.correction: Introduce a second axis of contrast (weight, width, case, tracking, family).

fingerprints.title: Universal hover-lift + shadow
fingerprints.description: Every card responds to hover with translateY(-4px) and increased shadow.
fingerprints.why_ai: Default hover polish across the entire generative-web output style.

detection.css_signal: multiple selectors sharing identical :hover transform + shadow rules

fingerprints.correction: Reserve hover feedback for interactive elements. Non-interactive cards do not move on hover.

fingerprints.title: Cursor-follows-everything
fingerprints.description: Custom cursor drives multiple simultaneous full-amplitude effects.
fingerprints.why_ai: One gesture cannot mean five things.

detection.js_signal: multiple mousemove-based transforms on one screen at full amplitude

fingerprints.correction: Pick one dominant pointer response per scene. Mute or disable others.

fingerprints.title: Emoji as feature icons
fingerprints.description: Emoji glyphs used as leading icons for feature blocks.
fingerprints.why_ai: Fastest visual shorthand, betraying the fastest visual decision.

detection.content_signal: emoji characters as leading glyphs for feature block headings

fingerprints.correction: Commit to an icon family with brand rationale or use no icons and let typography carry the block.

fingerprints.title: Fake dashboard / terminal decoration
fingerprints.description: Screenshot-style block showing fake dashboard, terminal, code, or chart to signal 'product' without showing the real product.
fingerprints.why_ai: Real product surfaces look inconvenient. Faked ones look clean because they were designed to look clean.

detection.content_signal: chart, terminal, or table with no live data and no link to the real product

fingerprints.correction: Show real product surface with real data, or do not show one. Do not fabricate.
